paras: Stresemann's bent-toed gecko (Cyrtodactylus stresemanni) is a species of lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to Malaysia.
The specific name, stresemanni, is in honor of German ornithologist Erwin Friedrich Theodor Stresemann.
C. stresemanni is found in Perak, Malaysia.
The preferred natural habitat of C. stresemanni is forest.
Medium-sized for its genus, C. stresemanni may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 9.5 cm (3.7 in) and a total length (including tail) of 19 cm (7.5 in).
